definitions.explanation: The act of transporting and delivering goods.

examples.japanese: {配送|はいそう}は{無料|むりょう}ですか？
{配送|はいそう}{日|び}を{指定|してい}できます。
examples.english: You can specify the delivery date.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}に{配送|はいそう}します。

notes:
{配送|はいそう} refers to the process of transporting and delivering goods to a destination. Combines {配|はい} (distribute) + {送|そう} (send).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {配送|はいそう}{料|りょう} (delivery fee)
- {配送|はいそう}{先|さき} (delivery destination)
- {配送|はいそう}{状況|じょうきょう} (delivery status)
- {配送|はいそう}{日|び} (delivery date)
- {即日|そくじつ}{配送|はいそう} (same-day delivery)
- {送料|そうりょう}{無料|むりょう}{配送|はいそう} (free shipping)
- {配送|はいそう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (delivery company)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {配達|はいたつ}: delivery (last-mile, to the recipient — e.g., mail, pizza)
- {発送|はっそう}: shipping/dispatch (from the sender's side)
- {出荷|しゅっか}: shipment (business/warehouse term)
- {宅配|たくはい}: home delivery (e.g., {宅配便|たくはいびん})

USAGE:
Very common in online shopping contexts. {配送|はいそう} covers the whole delivery process from warehouse to customer.
